jobs.description: The unit prices composed by DuckDB inside the publisher beside the Spark join they replace (root ADR-0317 §6, ADR-0564 §6; scripts/ops/gold-versions-build.sh unit-official-price → publisher build-unit-official-price-versions; unit_official_price_stage). While gold_panel_rebuild joins each vintage with Spark (unit_official_price.py) into silver.unit_official_price and unit_price_versions_migration carries each batch into silver.unit_official_price_versions, it is that join's shadow and writes nothing: it names the batch the readers read (the newest, unit_price_stage::batch), and its verdict (takeover_equal on 41) composes that batch's vintage at the pins its id names (price:<snapshot>|exclusive:<snapshot>|vintage:<yyyymm>) and compares the 시도's rows, as values, with the rows Spark wrote (export-unit-official-price-takeover-sides, engine_equality.py). A new batch is judged once; a verdict that did not run to its end runs again. It starts no Spark session, so it queues in the duckdb pool on its own unit's memory_claim, at weight 3: a shadow serves nothing. The switch makes it the writer of the versions table (each vintage's changed keys) and deletes the Spark join.
jobs.memory_measured: its own: run 20261119T152616Z of foundation-gold-versions@parcel-nearby (2026-11-19 15:26-15:51Z, every served parcel, 39,861,511 rows committed in 1500 s), systemd's memory peak 7.2G, swap peak 13.5M; the publisher's own peak in its run log 7,733,563,392 bytes
jobs.memory_headroom_why: The peak follows the cap, not the work: the publisher gives DuckDB three fifths of what the unit has left under MemoryHigh (parcel_nearby_versions_build MEMORY_SHARE) and DuckDB fills it and the page cache, so a larger memory_max would only raise the peak; the verdict's DuckDB is held to the unit's TAKEOVER_MEMORY_LIMIT. The run fit: no timeout, 13.5M swap, under MemoryMax

first_run.estimated_from: computed, not measured: the build reads the old table's metadata alone (seconds). Its verdict, bounded by the unit's TAKEOVER_SECONDS (1800), reads the batch's vintage of the price table at its pin (about 202 million rows, four of its columns), keeps the prices of 경기도's units (about a quarter: silver.unit_official_price holds 320.7M of its 1,207M rows in 41, #1626), resolves their notices, joins them to the units as of the vintage, reads Spark's rows of the batch in 41 (one partition) and compares the two by key. The Spark join of the whole nation took 2,569 s on 2026-11-22 (gold-panel-rebuild 15:14:36-15:57:25): about 1,800 s for one 시도 on DuckDB, most of it the price read.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: A shadow that writes nothing: every run is `unchanged`, and what it owes is a verdict of each new batch, which the takeover_equal check reports.

assets.title: 세대별 기준일 공시가격 판 버전
assets.description: 세대 가격 조합의 판마다 바뀐 (관리번호, 기준일) 키의 행과 사라진 키의 삭제 표시만 쌓는다. 어느 판이든 그 판 이하의 버전에서 키마다 가장 새 행으로 다시 만들며, 패널이 읽던 그 판의 묶음과 같다(루트 ADR-0317). 일회성 이행 잡이 옛 표에서 채우고, 독자 전환 전까지 읽는 소비자가 없어 섬으로 둔다. Spark 조합(unit_official_price.py)의 그림자 빌드(build-unit-official-price-versions)가 표에 아무것도 쓰지 않고, 가장 새 배치를 그 배치의 핀으로 발행기 안의 DuckDB 가 다시 조합해 Spark 의 행과 값으로 맞춘다(takeover_equal, 시도 41; 루트 ADR-0317 §6, ADR-0564 §6).

dependencies.description: 일회성 이행: 판마다 패널이 읽던 마지막 묶음을 바뀐 키만 버전 표에 쓰고, 판마다 재구성과 그 묶음을 양방향 비교한다(루트 ADR-0317).
